description: Creates a tunnel or slope cross-section.

keywords.name: tunnel-vertical-wall
keywords.description: Creates a tunnel cross-section with vertical side walls.

keywords.name: tunnel-double-arch
keywords.description: Creates a tunnel cross-section composed of two arches.

keywords.name: tunnel-horseshoe-3-arch
keywords.description: Creates a horseshoe-shaped tunnel cross-section defined by three circular arcs.

keywords.name: tunnel-horseshoe-5-arch
keywords.description: Creates a horseshoe-shaped tunnel cross-section defined by five circular arcs.

keywords.name: center
keywords.description: Specifies the center location of the tunnel cross-section.

keywords.name: full-section
keywords.description: Specifies whether a full ( true ) or half ( false ) cross-section is created.

keywords.name: slope-simple
keywords.description: Creates a cross-section of a basic (single) slope.

keywords.name: slope-1-bench
keywords.description: Creates a slope cross-section with one bench.

keywords.name: slope-2-bench
keywords.description: Creates a slope cross-section with two benches.

keywords.name: slope-3-bench
keywords.description: Creates a slope cross-section with three benches.

keywords.name: slope-open-pit
keywords.description: Creates a cross-section of an open-pit or of a slope with multiple benches.

keywords.name: origin
keywords.description: Specifies the origin location of the slope cross-section.

keywords.name: reverse
keywords.description: Controls the slope cross-section orientation. By default ( false ), the downstream side is located on the left. When true , the cross-section is reversed and the downstream side is located on the right.

keywords.name: internal
keywords.description: Specifies whether internal construction lines are included in the cross-section.
